course_info.trial_description:
If you are interested on TOEFL preparation, I will explain to you how my lessons work, evaluate your English so that we know in which of the four areas we need to focus on and share several materials with you.

If you are interested on conversation then we shall use this class to get to know each other better so that you can ascertain that my teaching style is suitable for you.

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL test preparation course
pro_course_detail.description:
While I lived in Asia I helped plenty of students to prepare for TOEFL, mostly pupils who had applied to study abroad in America and needed a TOEFL certificate before being accepted in the university of their choice. 

I can share several materials with you and guide you through the four areas you will be tested on: reading comprehension, listening comprehension, speaking proficiency and writing proficiency. I will evaluate you on those areas and determine which are the ones you need to focus on. Of course I will also listen to your input before personalizing my lessons to your taste.

pro_course_detail.title: Fun, professional lessons for your kid
pro_course_detail.description:
Fun, interactive lessons by a Qualified Primary School Teacher in the UK.

I will use movies, books, cartoons and fictional characters your child is familiar with (such as Harry Potter, Spider Man or Elsa) to make my lessons engaging and highly motivating.

We will play games, sings songs, and discuss several topics together. All the while, your child will learn English without realizing they are putting in any effort. Siblings of similar age are welcome to study together!

pro_course_detail.title: Let's talk about Pop Culture
pro_course_detail.description:
I am person who has traveled a lot and who follows popular culture from all over the world. Let's discuss about your favorite Avenger movie, or that famous Chinese drama which everybody is watching, or a long awaited book of Game of Thrones, Winds of Winter (aka: "the book which shall never see the light of day").

If you don't like popular culture, then let's have a discussion about history, international news, or even the new AI model developed by Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. Wudao2 is way too smart to be a machine, but that's just the future guys!

I'm very friendly and open minded and I'd love to meet people from all over the world. What better way to learn English than by sharing ideas and making a new friend?

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish Lessons made for you

pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the ultimate survival guide for sounding like a native speaker! 🚀 

This isn’t your typical 'repeat-after-me' language class—oh no. We’re diving into real-life expressions, slang, cultural quirks, and even the mysterious art of using the right tone (because yes, saying 'fine' can mean 27 different things). 

Learn how to blend in, avoid awkward misunderstandings, and master the local vibe so well that people will start asking YOU for directions. 

Less textbook, more real talk — let’s do this! 😆

pro_course_detail.title: Levantine dialect + MSA
pro_course_detail.description:
I teach Arabic beginning with the alphabet, progressing to reading small words and then longer phrases. The course extends to reading news in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), or Levantine Arabic. I specialize in teaching A1, A2, and B1 level students exclusively. We can start the course in a way that suits you best. I tailor the lessons to match your level, preferences, and specific learning needs.

For A1 and the first half of A2 levels, we concentrate on establishing the foundational elements of the language, while also engaging in friendly discussions about Arab/Egyptian pop culture, customs, and traditions. In the second half of A2 and throughout B1, we expand into everyday conversations in places like grocery stores, gas stations, and cafes.
